title: Empty Pockets
description: Entered the dungeon without supplies.

title: Why Aren't You Wearing Pants?
description: Entered the dungeon without pants.

title: Unarmed Combat
description: Entered the World Dungeon without a weapon.

title: Oooh, Magic!
description: Wore magical gear for the first time.

title: Boom!
description: Caused a wall-shaking explosion in the dungeon.

title: Podophilia!

reward.description: Gold Shoe Box containing the Enchanted Pedicure Kit of the Sylph

description: Killed an opponent by crushing it with bare feet.

title: Battlefield Construction!
description: Built and deployed a structure in battle.

title: Trailblazing Crazy Cat Lady
description: The first crawler to enter the World Dungeon with a cat.

title: Early Adopter
description: One of the first 5,000 crawlers to enter a new World Dungeon.

title: Loner
description: Entered without any human companions.

title: Fall into an Obvious Trap
description: No achievement notification text is preserved by the source.

reward.description: A warning that Carl is about to meet his maker.

title: You've Discovered and Read an Official Dungeon Sign
description: Read an official dungeon sign.

reward.description: Official signs are highlighted and nearby guilds appear on the minimap.

title: You've Inflicted Damage on a Mob
description: Damaged a mob for the first time.

reward.description: The mob will probably hit back.

title: You've Killed a Mob!
description: Killed a mob for the first time.

title: You've Killed an Armed Mob with Your Bare Fucking Hands!
description: Killed an armed mob with bare hands.

title: You've Killed a Mob a Higher Level Than Yourself!
description: Killed a mob above Carl’s level.

title: You've Entered a Guildhall!
description: Entered a guildhall.

title: Level-Up, Baby!
description: Gained enough experience to reach a new level.

reward.description: No extra reward beyond the level.

title: Loot!
description: Wore an item found in the dungeon.

title: Boss Babe
description: Damaged a dungeon boss.

title: You Monster!
description: Killed goblin children during the goblin chieftain-room explosion.

title: War Criminal
description: Killed more than twenty noncombatants with one attack.

title: Two Chicks at the Same Time
description: Killed two mobs at once by using their bodies against one another.

title: Borough Boss!
description: Entered a borough-boss chamber.

title: Bully and a Thief!
description: Inadvertently took Agatha’s shopping cart into inventory during the Ball of Swine fight.

title: This Little Piggy Went to Market!
description: Killed more than five opponents in boss fights with bare feet.

title: You Found Stairs!
description: Found a stairwell down to the next floor.

reward.description: No material reward; surviving to read the notification is the reward.

title: Crazy Cat Lady
description: Entered the World Dungeon accompanied by a cat.

title: Bitchmeat
description: Was attacked by a fellow crawler in a safe room and required the system’s help.

title: PETA Enthusiast!
description: Removed an aggravated non-sapient enemy’s hostility and caused it to fight other enemies.

title: Dungeonpreneur
description: Invented Carl’s Jug O’ Boom, a stackable dungeon device.

reward.description: A lifetime gold-coin royalty for kills other crawlers make with the invention.

title: What Goes Up...
description: Survived the Reverse Gravity spell.

reward.description: Carl can truthfully say he is more durable than Albert II, a rhesus monkey.

title: Like a Moth to the Flame
description: Damaged a mob more than 75 levels above the crawler.

reward.description: Platinum Lucky Bastard Box containing a lottery scratch-off ticket

title: Grease Monkey!
description: Built and deployed a wheeled device.

title: You Call That a Trap?
description: A mob was hurt by something Carl deliberately left in the dungeon.

title: I'll Take the Ceramic Dalmatian, Pat!
description: Discovered a reward room.

reward.description: No material reward; the reward room is the reward.

title: Menagerie!
description: Discovered a pet reward room.

reward.description: A key that opens one cage in the pet reward room.

title: Wait, Bosses Can Leave Their Rooms?
description: Encountered a boss that left its chamber before crawlers entered.

title: You Found Stairs
description: Found a stairwell down.
